arrival.speaker: venn_mother
arrival.text: Caelan. Is that from the sanctuary?

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: Serene asked me to bring these round. How’s the little one?

arrival.speaker: venn_mother
arrival.text: *with relief* Finally keeping food down. We’ve had a quieter morning, thank the gods.

arrival.speaker: venn_mother
arrival.text: Please thank Serene for us. I meant to come down myself, but—

arrival.speaker: venn_father
arrival.text: If this channel would cooperate, we might get a few things finished.

arrival.speaker: venn_father
arrival.text: *sighs* The gate’s caught. There’s water in the brook and hardly any reaching the far end of our plot. I can’t keep carrying buckets across all afternoon.

arrival.speaker: venn_father
arrival.text: Please. It’s east of the cottage. Look at the pin, then the channel below it.

arrival.speaker: venn_mother
arrival.text: Borrow what you need from the tool box.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: I’ll see what I can do.

resolution.speaker: venn_father
resolution.text: There it goes. That should reach the far end now.

resolution.speaker: venn_mother
resolution.text: One less thing to worry about.

resolution.speaker: venn_father
resolution.text: Often enough. They’ve got pumps in the capital that could fill these channels in half the time.

resolution.speaker: venn_mother
resolution.text: And payments that would take twice as long to finish.

resolution.speaker: venn_father
resolution.text: *defensively* I know. I’m only saying it would be useful.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: For today, at least, you’ve got the water moving again.

resolution.speaker: venn_mother
resolution.text: You’ve done us a kindness. Let Serene know we’ll be all right.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: I will. I hope we see you at the festival.

resolution.speaker: venn_mother
resolution.text: We’ll see how the little one feels. I’d like that.

resolution.speaker: venn_father
resolution.text: And if we do get there, I intend to sit down for a while.

resolution.speaker: venn_mother
resolution.text: *with a small laugh* You say that now.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: I’ll leave you to it. Take care.

reminder.speaker: venn_father
reminder.text: The gate is east of the cottage. Have a look at the pin and the channel below it.

reminder.speaker: venn_mother
reminder.text: Borrow what you need from the tool box.

pin.speaker: caelan
pin.text: The pin’s caught at an angle. I’ll need to take the pressure off before I set it straight.

channel.speaker: caelan
channel.text: Twigs have collected below the gate. I’ll need to clear those, too.

choice.speaker: caelan
choice.text: I could use their tools. Or perhaps I can push the water back long enough to free the pin.

after.speaker: venn_mother
after.text: Please let Serene know we’ll be all right. Thank you, Caelan.

hands_full.speaker: caelan
hands_full.text: I should set Elira’s lantern down safely before I take anything else in hand.

magicks_failed.speaker: caelan
magicks_failed.text: *quietly* I can’t move it. I’ll need the tools.
